entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just haven't been able to deal with it until now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF887-015. My name is Sarah Jenkins.

Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you'd like to return it. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh no, it's not broken. It's just... I bought it for my dad, but we've had a family emergency. He was rushed to the hospital right after it arrived and ended up needing major surgery.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

Thank you. It's been a lot. We've just been focused on that, and I completely forgot about the return window. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back. It's been a difficult time.
I completely understand, Sarah. Thank you for explaining the situation. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I review our current policies for you. One moment.
Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you have nothing to worry about. Our system shows that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? Ninety days? I thought it was shorter.
Yes, ma'am. Since your item was delivered 39 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, thank you! That is such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You're very welcome, Sarah. It's the least we can do. I've just sent the pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the refund processed within 5-7 business days after we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your father a speedy recovery.
